about: Third picture pass for the hauntings documentary (fetch.py --extra, Oct. 21, 2026): the 1869 bird's-eye view of Michigan City and the 1862 county map from the Library of Congress (skipped before because of how their free-to-use notice is worded), every drawing in the HABS survey of the lighthouse, Potawatomi pictures, old railroad water tanks, and full-resolution cut-outs of the 1905 headless-ghost stories and the 1910 Barker heiress stories found on the last pass. Same rules: public domain, CC0 or CC BY only.
